The '''R1-type shopkeeping drone''',<ref name="Inside the Worlds" /> also known simply as the '''R1-type drone''',<ref name="The Visual Dictionary" /> was a model of [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeping drone]] created by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]<ref name="Inside the Worlds" /> to assist with shopkeeping.<ref name="The Visual Dictionary" />
